name: Sweet Potato
intro: Sweet potatoes are a versatile and nutritious root vegetable, rich in beta-carotene and fiber. They are a staple in many cuisines and offer numerous health benefits.

name: Broccoli
intro: Broccoli is a nutrient-dense green vegetable known for its high vitamin C and K content, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties.

health_benefits.title: Anti-Inflammatory
health_benefits.explanation: Broccoli contains compounds that help reduce inflammation in the body, which can lower the risk of chronic diseases.

health_benefits.explanation: High in vitamin C and K, broccoli helps protect cells from damage by free radicals, supporting overall health.

health_benefits.explanation: The fiber content in broccoli promotes healthy digestion and can help prevent constipation.

health_benefits.title: Boosts Immunity
health_benefits.explanation: With a high vitamin C content, broccoli can help strengthen the immune system and fight off infections.
